Cure light wounds

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Cure_light_wounds

A cure light wounds potion or potion of cure light wounds seems to be a standard magical measure. Sosarian beef jerky cured in giant bee honey has the effects of a cure light wounds potion (50.14). In Greymere Vale (20.00), a torrent of cure light wounds potion falls constantly from a tower. Category:Victuals Category:Magic Category:Spells Category:Cattle
